title: feat: allow 32 MiB text request bodies
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Raises the shared text JSON request limit from 20 MiB to 32 MiB, including inline chat images.
- Returns a clear 413 error with the allowed size and documents the limit in the Chat, Responses, and Messages API schemas.
- Covers a 28 MiB chat request through the local Worker and a 33 MiB rejection; staging also returned the expected 413.

Direct OpenAI accepted a 23.9 MiB inline-image request; OpenRouter accepted 47.8 MiB. The 32 MiB Worker cap leaves headroom under its 128 MB memory limit.

Addresses #15889

gist.headline: More room in the hive
gist.blurb: The text API makes room for bigger requests, including chats with inline images. Oversized requests get a clear 413 instead of a guessing game.
gist.summary: The shared text JSON request limit rises from 20 MiB to 32 MiB, including inline chat images, with the limit documented in the Chat, Responses, and Messages schemas and reported in 413 errors.
gist.impact: Developers can send text requests up to 32 MiB, while requests over the limit receive a 413 response stating the allowed size.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the text API as a cozy garden post office: Polli guides a large chat envelope containing a little picture through a gate marked 32 MiB, with code-plants growing nearby. A small, friendly 413 sign shows where the size boundary is.
